item.title: Two people arrested for multiple drug-related crimes in Ozark County
item.description: The Ozark County Sheriff's Office arrested Gary and Venessia Donley for their alleged involvement in drug-related crimes after serving a search warrant on their residence and seizing over 24 grams of meth and Hydrocodone pills.

item.title: Supermoon: First full moon of 2026 to illuminate night sky
item.description: The first full moon of 2026, also known as the Wolf Moon, is a supermoon, making it appear larger and brighter in the night sky, though cloudy skies may obscure the view.

item.title: Missouri debates increasing rural highway speed to 75 mph
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Missouri drivers may soon be able to pick up the pace on rural highways. State Rep. Jamie Burger, R-Cape Girardeau, has pre-filed a bill for the 2026 legislative session that would increase the maximum speed limit on rural interstates from 70 to 75 mph. item.title: Felony charges dropped in fatal Branson Duck Boat tragedy
item.description: A Stone County judge has dismissed more than 60 felony charges against a Branson duck boat captain and two supervisors involved in the July 2018 deadly Ride the Ducks sinking, which resulted in the deaths of 17 people.
